entry_state: Conditioning on the latest diagonal differs from conditioning on the full observed triangle. Forward moments do not determine a backward law, and reserve errors must subtract reserve estimates rather than ultimate estimates. The published conditional simulation has its own constructed backward model.
exit_state: Bootstrap validation must match the chosen horizon, conditioning and centering. Even a justified payment law leaves the insurer's compensation method and tolerance to choose. A discrete tail calculation must retain the required portion of probability at its quantile boundary.
findings: The bootstrap conclusion preserves reported simulation observations without claiming local replication or statistical ranking.
The authored payment law has mean 7/2; a total measure 31/4 implies additional compensation 17/4, conditional on choosing that measure.
At alpha 3/5 the left quantile is 4. The upper forty percent includes all probability at 10 and only part of the atom at 4. No new defect observed.
